purpose: Use the least expensive model that reliably performs each evaluation stage while preserving isolated, comparable API-role responses.

isolatedApiResponse.isolation: Give the model exactly one saved request string and no other evaluation or app context.

appliesTo: apply the acceptance rubric when no judgment conflict exists
unresolved or contradictory failures after a Terra medium attempt

escalationRules: Do not choose a stronger model merely because a suite contains more cases; batch repetitive cases instead.

Raise isolatedApiResponse from Luna low to Luna medium only if the saved output is malformed, violates the supplied contract, or fails the v1 calibration comparison in a way attributable to response quality.
Use Terra medium only for cases or stages requiring diagnosis, code changes, or substantial judgment.
Use Sol medium only after Terra medium leaves a concrete failure unresolved or produces conflicting diagnoses.
Do not use high, xhigh, max, or ultra effort unless a future run records evidence that medium failed and the higher effort corrected the failure.
provenanceRule: For every generated response, record the actual model and effort on that response round. Record any deviation from this policy and its reason in the suite findings.
availabilityRule: If a named model is unavailable, choose the cheapest available model in the same role (efficient, balanced, or workhorse), preserve the effort level, and record the substitution.
